Thick reconstructible parts; no wires, chains, delicate horns, thin spikes or isolated floating components.

blind.details: There are no texts, labels, or watermarks in the image. The composition features two main connected objects: a heavy anvil at the bottom and a large hammer resting on its top face (best guess: a fantasy dwarven anvil and warhammer prop; second guess: a blacksmith crafting station 3D game asset). The anvil consists of a flat top with a tapered horn, a sturdy central column, and a multi-tiered faceted base. The hammer features an oversized blocky head with beveled edges, a cylindrical handle wrapped in brown spiral leather strapping, and an octagonal pommel cap. The central column of the anvil and the side of the hammer head each feature an inset four-pointed diamond star emblem glowing with fiery yellow-orange light, with similar molten glow radiating from recesses and cracks in the base. The pommel also has a smaller inset glowing diamond. The materials resemble chiseled dark charcoal-grey iron or volcanic stone with realistic scratches, weathered highlights, and brown leather strapping. The entire object cluster is fully contained within the frame with no cropping. The background is a clean, uniform solid white with no scenery, floor shadows, or people.
